Name: More Rain
Author: Omegasis
Description:
Lets you adjust the probability of rain and storms for each season.

[b][color=#6aa84f]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.4+ on Linux, Mac, and Windows. Requires SMAPI 3.0  or later.[/color][/b]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Usage[/size]
After you run the game once with the mod, a [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] will appear in the game folder. Edit that file in a text editor to change the probability of rain, storms, or snow for each season. Each value is a percentage value between 0 and 100.

It won't rain on days where a wedding or a festival would take place.

[size=4]New in Version 1.9.0
[/size]Due to popular request the config file now allows you to to set the priority for checking for thunderstorms before rainy days. Just set the config options to true for each season. (Default false for Spring and Fall but true for Summer).

Also you can now set it to snow in fall and rain in winter. This is disabled by default but can be enabled in the config file. You can also set their respective weather chances in the config file as well.
